correctness.rationale: The uniform correlation matrix is the Gram matrix of p independent uniform unit vectors in R^(p+1). In the trace expansion, adjacent repeated indices vanish. The three remaining index-pattern classes have counts p(p-1)(p-2)(p-3), 2p(p-1)(p-2), and p(p-1), with exact expectations (p+1)^(-3), (p+1)^(-2), and 3/((p+1)(p+3)). Their sum simplifies to the stated rational formula. Exact rational enumeration supplements the proof.
